prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original character design reference sheet for a first-person noir comic brawler.
Create ONE portrait-format, high-resolution SIX CHARACTER lineup, three columns by two rows, full bodies with generous clean separation, plain flat light neutral gray background, no scenery and no cast shadows. Reference image is ONLY the drawing-language reference: strong black exterior contours, thinner interior lines, two or three broad flat shadow masses, muted colors, hand-drawn graphic-novel sprites. Do not copy the ordinary civilian identity or the sideways gaze from the reference.
These SIX ADULT EAST ASIAN HUMAN CHARACTERS are a conspicuous ruthless fictional river-port extortion gang, with distinct faces and body types, period workwear turned into intimidating gang clothes. Every face is directed toward the viewer and BOTH EYES make unmistakable direct eye contact with the camera. Bodies may be angled 10 degrees but HEADS FACE FRONT. Aggressively lowered brows, compressed lips or a contemptuous small sneer, shoulders pushing toward the viewer, assertive street-fighting readiness. They are recognizable villains even at thumbnail size. Human anatomy, no monster traits, no superhero physique.
Order left to right, top row:
1. Lean adult male debt collector: narrow waist, angular face, short dark hair swept back, open rust-red short jacket over a charcoal shirt, dark loose trousers, plain dark brass belt buckle, dark red wrap on RIGHT wrist, scuffed thick boots. No courier bag or cap. Weight forward, a provocative little sneer, one lowered clenched fist.
2. Broad adult male enforcer: thick neck, broad square shoulders and heavy forearms, close-cropped dark hair, hard square jaw, dark charcoal structured shoulder vest over an open-collar cream shirt with rolled sleeves, loose dark trousers, heavy boots, worn dark-red wraps on both hands, plain dark brass buttons. Heavy lowered brow, clenched jaw, slightly raised boxing fists that DO NOT cover the eyes. No cap.
3. Wiry adult female interceptor: short sharp dark bob, fitted faded blue-green cropped jacket with pronounced collar, dark trousers, dark-red band on LEFT upper arm and plain dark brass fasteners. No tool pouch or apron. Elbows held clear of torso, tight mouth, icy confrontational DIRECT gaze.
Bottom row:
4. Older lean adult male gang veteran: weathered angular face, gray at temples, low dark soft cap that does not hide eyes, short indigo-gray jacket, dark red neck knot, plain dark brass belt clasp, practical dark boots. Upright wiry shoulders, balanced planted feet, deliberate contemptuous glare at viewer. No stooped frail stance.
5. Tall narrow adult male gang boss: short slick dark hair, small neat mustache, dark brown knee-length open coat with hard pointed lapels over charcoal clothing, narrow dark-red cloth strip below lapel, plain dark brass belt buckle. Direct cold gaze, one corner of mouth raised, hands positioned to threaten, coat opens enough to show legs.
6. Compact sturdy adult female bruiser: tightly tied dark headscarf, mustard-ochre short jacket, strong dark work gloves, dark-red band on LEFT wrist, plain dark brass jacket buttons, broad dark trousers, thick boots. Shoulders lowered forward, square stance, fierce front-facing narrowed eyes, fists in front with face unobstructed.
Keep all heads, hands and boots completely inside each cell. Clearly separate silhouettes. Shared restrained ink-and-flat-color language, normal adult proportions. Flat neutral illumination compatible with later cold ambient and warm local light; no dramatic rim glow. No weapons, blood, injuries, words, letters, numbers, grid lines, labels, insignia text, branding, logos or watermarks. Draw exactly these six people once each. This is a new appearance reference sheet, not an animation sheet.
